summary: dsh-vm-tester ships an agent/tunnel-host component combining child_process and HTTP
details: The package ships agent/tunnel-host.js, which imports child_process and performs HTTP GET requests. The co-occurrence of process spawning and HTTP in a file named 'tunnel-host' within a package self-described as a VM tester is a shape that can correspond to a legitimate remote-execution agent for VM testing or to a covert remote-control channel; traced behavior is not available to distinguish the two. No install-time or import-time lifecycle hook, no exfiltration of installer secrets, and no attacker-controlled destination has been concretely identified in the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
